dimension.category_description: How multiple possibilities are presented, previewed, maintained, blended, or compared before commitment.
dimension.classification_boundary: Requires a visible choice or comparison mechanism, not backend candidate-set processing alone.

patterns.short_summary: At a single decision point the system emits more than one alternative for the same request and presents them together as a set.
Two or more instances of the same kind of artifact are displayed simultaneously in parallel regions so that their differences can be read off directly.
The interaction is organized as a tree or open graph in which alternatives coexist, rather than as a single ordered track the user advances along.
A single user request is dispatched unchanged to several distinct models at once, and their outputs are returned together.
The interface takes an input the model has already been run on, applies a controlled alteration to it, re-runs the model, and presents the altered-input output against the original one.
The user selects two or more existing items and invokes an operation whose product is a single fused result rather than either operand.
